title: Evidence-Grounded Content Generation Boundary
status: governance-defined; Layer 1, Phase B policy defaults, bounded-hybrid ownership, and Phase C metadata-first persistence policy approved; implementation remains separately authorized
scope: approved Product, Offer, Audience, Positioning, Strategy and Customer Segment evidence authority
one logical versioned tenant-and-brand Voice authority
deterministic anti-generic and evidence-bound factuality validation

versioned policy-pack governance without implementation authority

approved Product, Offer, Audience, Positioning, Strategy and Customer Segment evidence remains owned by existing domains
provider output never authorizes claims, approval or workflow transitions
high-risk unsupported, stale, revoked, conflicting and cross-tenant claims are blocked
unknown and low-confidence claims are review_required and cannot be approved until resolved or explicitly revalidated
exact replay is distinct from regeneration
bounded generation and asset lifecycle with immutable rejection and supersession
Campaign Asset remains lifecycle owner and operation claims own only coordination, replay and recovery
missing and cross-tenant resources return indistinguishable safe responses
no execution, publishing, spend, learning, deployment or release authority
approved_defaults: one logical versioned tenant-and-brand Voice authority; existing VoiceProfile may adapt but is not a parallel authority
new raw grounding content is not persisted before retention, deletion, privacy and ownership policy approval
destructive deletion remains disabled until retention and legal-hold policy is approved
existing platform encryption and security controls are reused without a new encryption commitment
machine-readable error codes remain internal and provider-neutral until public compatibility is approved

Campaign Asset/Asset Revision remains the sole customer-facing artifact and lifecycle owner; a subordinate Generation Attempt record is permitted only for operational provenance, retries, provider results, validation and crash recovery
phase_b_locked_defaults: the anti-generic safety floor is three semantically distinct anchors spanning at least two source categories
channel/content-type policy packs may require additional anchors and structure
Architecture/Quality owns policy versioning, compatibility, rollback and golden-corpus governance
evidence domains retain authority over source meaning and lifecycle
high-risk claims require direct approved evidence
derived claims require deterministic approved transformations, complete evidence lineage, unit preservation and no unsupported extrapolation
unknown and low-confidence claims are review_required and cannot be approved unresolved
high-risk, stale, revoked, expired, superseded, conflicting, digest-invalid and cross-tenant claims are blocked
policy packs are append-only and versioned; rollback affects only new requests
historical snapshots and validation results are never silently reinterpreted
phase_c_locked_decision: Campaign Asset/Asset Revision remains the sole customer-facing artifact and lifecycle owner
a subordinate Generation Attempt record is permitted only for operational provenance, retries, provider results, validation and crash recovery
Generation Attempt must not own assets, approvals, workflow state, evidence, publishing or customer-facing lifecycle
operation claims remain coordination and replay records only; existing evidence domains retain evidence ownership
asset revisions are immutable and tenant-and-brand-bound
exact replay returns the original persisted result without provider invocation; regeneration creates a new request identity and immutable successor
contradictory, missing, cross-tenant or digest-invalid state fails closed without mutation
schema, migration, persistence, retention, archival, deletion, encryption and legal-hold implementation requires separate authorization
this decision authorizes no application, database, API, workflow, provider, publishing, execution, spend, learning, deployment or release implementation
phase_c_metadata_first_policy: persist tenant-and-brand-bound asset and immutable revision identity

persist generation identity, snapshot digest, snapshot schema and canonicalization versions, source references, output digest, validation outcome, policy-pack identity, safe findings, provider/model provenance, workflow references and revision lineage
raw grounding snapshot content is not persisted in this phase

mutable timestamped files are insufficient as the authoritative replay store

encryption/key ownership and raw-content persistence require separate authorization
no parallel asset, approval, evidence, workflow or operation-claim owner is created
